instagram.caption:
The chip in your phone started as sand. Here's how it becomes billions of transistors 💻

Silicon is purified, melted and grown into a single-crystal ingot, sliced into wafers and polished to a mirror. Circuits are printed with light; the most advanced machines make extreme ultraviolet light by hitting about 50,000 tiny tin droplets a second with lasers. Layer by layer, billions of transistors form, then the wafer is cut into chips.
